name: Jupiter
tagline: The giant — more massive than every other planet combined.
history: Jupiter formed first among the planets and its gravity shaped everything after — shepherding asteroids, stirring the early solar nebula and flinging comets into and out of the inner system. Galileo Galilei's 1610 discovery of four moons circling it proved not everything orbits Earth; those Galilean satellites — Io, Europa, Ganymede, Callisto — remain prime ocean-world targets, with ESA's JUICE probe en route to Ganymede. The Great Red Spot is an anticyclone wider than Earth that has raged for centuries. NASA's Juno orbiter has mapped its deep weather and interior since 2016.
